Roth }} '''Determination''' is an [[aura]] skill that grants flat [[armour]] rating and more [[armour]] multiplicatively to the caster and their [[Ally|allies]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Armour''': This aura multiplies the player's total [[armour]] by the listed amount. For more information about auras in general, see [[aura]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = More
Armour |c1_header = You and nearby allies gain x% more Armour |c1_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies gain (%d+)%% more Armour |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = Additional
Armour |c2_header = You and nearby allies gain x additional Armour |c2_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies gain (%d+) additional Armour |c2_pattern_value = %d |c3_abbr = Radius |c3_header = +x metres to radius |c3_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c3_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Determination cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. The aura does not grant additional Armour, and instead grants "{{c|mod|You and nearby allies gain (40-59)% more Armour}}", increasing by 1% per level. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Determination: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Determination%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Determination: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Determination%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following [[modifier]]s are related to Determination:

These Synthesis implicit are able to find in pre-[[synthesised item]] or added via [[Harvest]] mechanics: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Determination%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |domain=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be find in legacy item in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Determination%" AND domain = 1 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 |domain=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Determination%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Determination%" OR items.description LIKE "%your aura%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now provides "You and nearby Allies gain 90 additional Armour" at gem level 1 (previously 179), scaling up to 1026 at gem level 20 (previously 2051). * {{Ruthless}} Determination now provides "You and nearby Allies gain 40% more Armour" at gem level 1 (previously 55%), scaling up to 59% at gem level 20 (previously 74%). }} {{Version history table row|3.22.0| * {{Ruthless}} Determination no longer causes you and nearby allies to gain additional Armour in Ruthless. In Ruthless, it now has "You and nearby allies gain 55% more Armour" at gem level 1 (previously 40%), scaling up to 74% at gem level 20 (previously 49%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Determination has been buffed to provide both a flat bonus to Armour, as well as its existing “more” multiplier to Armour. }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Anomalous Determination now grants you and nearby allies 0.25% chance to avoid being stunned per 1% gem quality (from 1% per 1% gem quality). * Divergent Determination now grants you and nearby allies 0.1% of evasion rating as extra armour per 1% gem quality (from 0.5% per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative quality. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving. * All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less. * Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine). }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Mana reserved reduced to 50%. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0| * Mana reserved standardized to 60%. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.12u| * Fixed a bug where the aura was broken by the last patch. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.12t| * Now provides a multiplicative increase to [[armour]] starting at 32% at level 1, rather than an additive increase of 20%. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Determination has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
